voice.name: Sulafat
voice.style: Calm, warm, confident narrator for a short film about how a video is made, speaking to people who make things. Natural and friendly, never salesy. The opening question is curious and light. Then steady and clear, one step at a time, with short pauses at commas. The last line is slower and lands softly.

title: No camera.
No footage.
scenes.line: No camera and no footage. So how was this film made?

scenes.label: The story
scenes.title: Write the story first
scenes.line: First the story: a hook on the first frame, one thing to follow, and every line approved word for word.

items.text: A hook on the first frame

scenes.label: The voice
scenes.title: An AI voice reads it
scenes.line: Then an AI voice reads it, and every word gets a time, so the picture lands on the word.

scenes.label: The music
scenes.title: Cut on the beat
scenes.line: The music is cut on the beat, so its strongest bar hits the payoff.

items.label: the bar that hits the payoff

scenes.label: The checks
scenes.title: Check before sending
scenes.line: And before anyone sees it, a blind transcript checks that every line made it in.

items.text: Is every line in the film?
All of them, in order. Nothing cut off.

title: One story.
Drawn in code.
scenes.line: That's how: one story, a moving camera, and not a single frame filmed.

scenes.name: Your film here
scenes.tagline: Every word of it lives in film.json
scenes.line: Now tell your own story, one line at a time.
